title: The Shadow Priest -- Beta
changeNote:
0.1.1 - Purple DoT damage preview

- Enemy health bars now show upcoming Touch, Pain, and Madness damage in purple. A fully purple remaining bar indicates enough DoT damage to deplete that HP.
- Updates immediately with current stacks and Mastery, including negative Mastery. Accounts for Intangible, Buffer, and the Heart's remaining damage cap.
- Normal Poison keeps its green preview.
- Preview covers the next natural DoT ticks, not Halo or future card plays. Enemy revivals and phase transitions still work normally.

Quality-of-life update only; no card or balance changes. Restart the game after Steam downloads the update.
